text: The application documents in other languages must be notarized in English or Chinese. 1. Log into the HIT online application system to complete the application form. 2. Passport homepage. 3. Senior high school diploma or expected graduation certificate. 4. High school transcript. 5. Language proficiency certificates. Note: Applicants who apply for Chinese Language and Literature do not need to provide language qualification certificates. 6. Recent Physical Examination Record for Foreigner. 7. Non-criminal record report (usually issued within six months before the application submission date). 8. Curriculum Vitae. 9. Remittance voucher of application fee (CNY400/CNY600 ). 10. Certificate of deposit (at least CNY20,000 or equivalent foreign currency). 11. Proof of outstanding academic achievements, sports, art, cultural exchanges, public welfare activities, etc. (not mandatory).
